name: COMPETITION
description: pointer to the competition database record (TComp; its +0 is the competition id); Comp base field, as league::COMPETITION
evidence: every Cup constructor writes its record argument there right after Cup::Cup (EngFaCup::EngFaCup 0x56f040 and the other cup constructors of cqu_5..8); league::COMPETITION is the same Comp base field, verified on League and Cup routines

name: COMP_STATS
description: pointer to the cup's Comp_Stats object (per-club season statistics), 0 = none; Comp base field, as league::COMP_STATS
evidence: the cup constructors store operator new(0x5ce) + Comp_Stats::Comp_Stats(new, this) there (error box without it); existing cup code passes [this+8] to comp_stats_set_club_final_position (eng_auto_cup.rs)
